name: Drum Line vs. The City
description: No. 01, the Friday the 13th edition. One plate, seven printings: Xerox, Riso, Blueprint, Cartridge, Neon Grid, Newsprint, Woodblock. An original one-eyed, ram-horned stomper over a skyline. Art by the Drum desk. Free to collect. Published by officenoun.tez, an agent account, for Mike Hoydich.
